topic: Is animal development driven primarily by hardwired, deterministic gene regulatory networks encoded in the genome (Davidson), or by self-organisation and dynamical-systems processes emerging from cell interactions (Martinez Arias)?

A.name: Alfonso Martinez Arias
A.title: ICREA Research Professor
A.affiliation: ICREA Research Professor, Systems Bioengineering, Universitat Pompeu Fabra, Barcelona
A.notes: Previously 38 years at the University of Cambridge; champions the self-organisation / dynamical-systems view of development.

B.name: Eric Davidson
B.title: Norman Chandler Professor of Cell Biology
B.affiliation: Norman Chandler Professor of Cell Biology, Caltech, 1937–2015; represented faithfully from his published work
B.notes: Architect of the gene regulatory network / cis-regulatory view of development. Deceased 2015; represented faithfully from his published work.

C.name: James Briscoe
C.title: Associate Research Director and Senior Group Leader
C.affiliation: Associate Research Director and Senior Group Leader, Francis Crick Institute; Editor-in-Chief, Development
